claims.value: Male figure, moai kavakava, made of wood, with inlaid eye of obsidian, bone (?). Prominent rib cage.
Height: 40 centimetres Width: 6.50 centimetres Depth: 9 centimetres

Tied-on typewritten cardboard label: '15. WOODEN FIGURE. Entered in Donation Book for 1850 as "A 'Fetish' from the Gold Coast. Cape Coast Castle. Presd. by E. Staunton Esq." In exhibition case labelled 'Easter Island'. Warwick Mus. Loan No. E.1/15.'
